text:
maria.sre: :rotating_light: Noticed multiple alerts didn't page the on-call group. Incident-bot shows delivery errors and webhook retries. Customers seeing 503s on /generate for ~10m. Anyone else seeing paging gaps?

 dcerk.ops: looking — I see the notify-bus has a backlog and the webhook worker restarted twice. getting logs now.

 incident-bot: automated: delivery_failed (webhook://pagerduty/api/v1/alerts) 12/18 attempts, last_status=502. retrying in 30s.

 maria.sre: can someone manually page while we investigate? PD auto-escalation didn't fire.

 derek.ops: manual page done to on-call alias. tara.eng-oncall: I got it, joining now. sending ack. :thumbsup:

 maria.sre: thanks. quick note — we're seeing a spike in webhook 502s from notify-bus -> pd-proxy. suspect TLS handshake errors after the pd-proxy deploy 8m ago.

 ops-tooling: dump of last 50 errors from notify-bus: ```
[2026-03-15T18:01:32Z] ERROR notify-worker: pd-proxy 502 Bad Gateway, conn reset
[2026-03-15T18:02:01Z] ERROR notify-worker: timeout writing to socket
[2026-03-15T18:04:09Z] WARN  notify-worker: retrying (4/5)```

 derek.ops: I can repro locally hitting pd-proxy -> returns 502 consistently for /v2/enqueue. curl output: ```
$ curl -v https://pd-proxy.internal/api/v2/enqueue
* Connected to pd-proxy.internal (10.2.3.7) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake to pd-proxy failed: error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:tlsv1 alert internal error
* Closing connection 0
```

 tara.eng-oncall: rolling back the pd-proxy deploy now. leaving manual paging in place until we confirm.

 maria.sre: customer impact — several production customers hit 503s on generation endpoints because retries exhausted at the front proxy. Some queued requests dropped. SLO at risk. Adding tags for affected customers now.

 ops-tooling: rollback started, monitoring notify-bus backlog. current backlog 2200 messages -> processing paused.

 derek.ops: I toggled notify-bus to fail-open mode (skip PD webhook) so alerts will be logged to alerts-fallback and we can page via manual PD trigger for now. Command run: ```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap notify-config -p '{"data":{"fail_open":"true"}}'
```

 incident-bot: automated: alert_fallback active; paging via alerts-fallback channel enabled.

 tara.eng-oncall: I confirm manual PD page went out and paging is working via fallback. continuing triage.

 maria.sre: handoff plan — tara will take lead on triage & rollback validation, derek will follow up on root cause of TLS errors, ops-tooling to file postmortem and track missed pages + runbook gaps.

 derek.ops: early hypothesis: cert chain issue on pd-proxy after cert rotation script ran during deploy. collecting cert logs.

 ops-tooling: creating incident ticket now and tagging for severity P1. ticket: INC-2026-0456. Action items: 1) postmortem, 2) add PD delivery metrics alert to detect mass 5xx to webhook, 3) add testing in canary deploy for pd-proxy TLS handshake.

 maria.sre: thanks all. keep this thread for updates. if anyone else sees missed pages from other bots, add here. I'll update customers via status page draft and ops will run a targeted notify to affected accounts. :white_check_mark:
